body.name: Symmetric quotient encoder pseudometric
body.construction: For one alignment \((\pi,\phi)\in\mathfrak S_n\ltimes\mathrm{Diff}(\mathbb T)^n\), set \(L_{\theta\leftarrow\widetilde\theta}(\pi,\phi)^2=\int\sum_{i\in[n]}\operatorname{dist}_{\mathbb T}\{h_{\theta i}(y),\phi_i(h_{\widetilde\theta,\pi(i)}(y))\}^2d\bar P_\theta(y)\) and \(L_{\widetilde\theta\leftarrow\theta}(\pi,\phi)^2=\int\sum_{j\in[n]}\operatorname{dist}_{\mathbb T}\{h_{\widetilde\theta j}(y),\phi_{\pi^{-1}(j)}^{-1}(h_{\theta,\pi^{-1}(j)}(y))\}^2d\bar P_{\widetilde\theta}(y)\). Define \(d_{\mathrm{rep}}(\theta,\widetilde\theta)=\inf_{\pi,\phi}\max\{L_{\theta\leftarrow\widetilde\theta}(\pi,\phi),L_{\widetilde\theta\leftarrow\theta}(\pi,\phi)\}\). The same alignment and its algebraic inverse are used in the two directions.
